svg.aria-label: A two-cylinder hot-air engine on a test bench, both barrels sectioned open at the front so the gas shows. The left barrel is banded with a gas heater, the right one jacketed in cooling water, and a short duct joins the two heads through a finned regenerator. Each piston is a trunk piston whose rod runs down to its own throw on the crankshaft; the throws sit a quarter turn apart. The flywheel on the left carries a Prony brake working a spring balance, a gas cock and a water pump stand in the foreground, and two pressure gauges behind.
